chunks: About a muhrim tying his izar around his neck, he said: "No."

key_terms.إِزَارَهُ: his izar, a waist-wrapper or loincloth
key_terms.الْأَعْرَجُ: al-A'raj, the epithet of the narrator Sa'id
key_terms.الْمُحْرِمِ: a person in the state of ihram
key_terms.سَعِيدٌ: Sa'id, the named questioner in the report

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim tie his izar around his neck during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning dress in the state of ihram. It states that a muhrim is not permitted to tie his izar around his neck.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2641 - Sa'id al-A'raj asked Imam (as) about a Muhrim tying his loincloth (izar) around his neck.
Imam (as) said: "No."
